comment:
At first, I was opposed to any AI use whatsoever, but I've since changed my mind. I think it's okay if you use AI for assistance in programming the app if you need it, but I don't want AI features in the app itself. I'm very comfortable using Buckets and it has all the features I need, and I love the look of it. I don't need an AI in there bloating the software with a feature that I won't ever find useful. 

I would like to see a preference setting added that will automatically open the app to the current month, though, because that's a feature I sorely need. Every single time, at the start of the month, I find myself entering transactions only to realise afterward that it was still at the end of the previous month. Very annoying.
